scope: Ordinary Monday–Saturday Propers in Lent weeks I–V excluding Ember Wednesday/Friday/Saturday and separate Passion Week Friday Marian formularium

specialCases.note: Use the prior Ember architecture; no duplicate Lenten ownership.
Greek additions/book ordering require the existing Esther cross-edition warning; never invent a parallel citation.
Gospel source inherited from Sancti/07-22 (Luke 7:36–50); do not adopt the Magdalene feast rank/collects.
Text belongs to the Lenten day and source owner, not to Pentecost liturgical day.
Only source-ordered LectioL1 receives Ezekiel; intervening collect and gradual have no Bible button.

File is Seven Sorrows of BVM, whose Friday observance and Mass formularies differ by 1962 general calendar vs local/SSPX uses. Until the actual ordinary ferial sourcePath is verified, do not make this Marian source the universal Passion Friday default.

policy: Source-file identity and actual selected Latin Epistle/Gospel incipit required; no date or word-search fallback.
Preserve Vulgate original verse groups; omitting a verse must remain visible in the semicolon-separated reference.
Do not infer Vulgate-to-CPDV/Crampon/Greek Esther concordance from one label.
Original Missal Latin order/extra lessons and reader state/rails cannot be overridden by this optional shared Bible overlay.
No new Scripture text licence, duplicate Bible reader, or rite adaptation.
